title: [narrowed from route-edit-85d03bc3] In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts, add one small self-contained helper function
description: [narrowed from route-edit-85d03bc3] In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts, add one small self-contained helper function at the TOP LEVEL of the module, immediately before the line that reads `async function recordGoalPath(` — do not insert anything inside an existing function, and do not modify any existing code in this change. The helper is exactly this shape and must be balanced on its own: an async function named `landedShaForGoalHash` taking `(vessel: string, h: string)` and returning `Promise<string | null>`. Its body: if `!vessel || vessel.includes("..") || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}$/.test(h)` return null; then inside a single try/catch that returns null on any error, spawn `Bun.spawn(["git", "-C", `/workspace/git/vessels/${vessel}`, "log", "origin/dev", "-1", "--format=%H", `--grep=route-edit-${h}`], { stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" })`, read stdout with `await new Response(proc.stdout).text()`, `await proc.exited`, trim it, and return the trimmed value only if it matches `/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/`, otherwise null. Model the Bun.spawn call on the existing one at line 10907 which already runs `git -C dir show` the same way. This change adds a function and nothing else — no call sites, no edits to existing lines — so it must typecheck cleanly and cannot alter any current behavior. A previous attempt at this failed by inserting an unbalanced block into a nested try/catch inside the edit-intent escalation path and produced `Expected "finally" but found "return"`; adding a flat top-level function instead avoids that entirely.
